keyFindings.description: After #2619, a queued approval skips the root's own gate, so a gate that held approved=N below latest=N+1 still reads that way when the person approves N+1. The queued todo re-admits the root, keepStaleApproval keeps (N, N+1), and the new architect's start task says 'approved at version N and now at version N+1: request approval of version N+1' about a version the person just approved. The architect then repeats the armed-gate steps and may ask the person again. Record the approval on the root's own gate without a notice when the handover queues (or have keepStaleApproval read Dispatch's approval), and test the readmit.
